blurb: The Three Peaks Mountain Trail Challenge Course is a premier obstacle course designed by Mark Bolender for mountain trail riding. It is open to the public and suitable for beginners and advanced riders, used for clinics, shows, and training. The course includes various obstacles such as suspension bridge, balance beams, water box, maze, and more.

extraNote: Organized events may require a Special Recreation Permit from BLM Cedar City Field Office · No vehicles or trailers allowed on the course; park in designated parking area · Do not add or remove obstacles · Do not use the course during adverse weather conditions such as mud or snow · No horse carts allowed · No vandalism or destruction of obstacles · Three Peaks Recreation Area west of Cedar City
